invariants.rationale: A method returning a List<WriteStatus> from JavaBulkInsertHelper.bulkInsert is expected to return a non-null result.
Parallelism (numOutputGroups) is expected to be positive; negative or zero would not be meaningful for clustering.
The instantTime is a String commit identifier and should not be null for clustering operations.
The result is cast to a List<WriteStatus> and should conform to this interface.
fileGroupIdList is passed to the method and clustering typically relies on a collection of file group IDs being non-null.
